authority: 2026-10-10 user skyline 63u85ldulqphukissen1d.jpeg. Individually authored compositions on original mapped footprints and heights, not random family selections. Unless a record supplies individual evidence, its lower wings, setbacks and elevations are skyline-led architectural interpretations, not surveyed or individually photo-verified buildings. Existing bespoke landmarks are excluded.

designs.evidence: Correct Indira Gandhi/Morogoro property confirmed by operator. Exterior inspected; cropped roof and rear are restrained interpretations. Preserve mapped levels despite operator's different floor count.
